searchText: Could EL teams chime in here before the testing call today please? If there are any branches already including the `baseFeeUpdateFraction`, then let me know: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1328758525979262986 The MEV workflow is now working with the mock builder from <@491624610215886849> 😄 I was able to get all clients except prysm and nimbus working, so it would be great if you can have a look at it we've started running the execution spec tests as regular transactions on devnet 5 a few minutes ago.. looks like that split the network into 3 forks after the first few transactions already. looks like we have 3 major fork chains: 1 geth 2 nethermind/reth 3 besu nice At least tests work Yeh the tests have been great 😊 Ok docker novice question, how do I wipe the docker data and restart it? I want to restart the ethereumjs teku instance from scratch. If I restart it, it just runs into the same issue, so I think data got corrupted stop the container, clear the datadir and start it again 🙂 if it's one of our devnet nodes, the data is usually located in `/data/ethereumjs` Thanks 😄 Yes checking our devnet 5 node 🙂 Are there details how to access the nodes somewhere? Are 7702 tests sent to devnet-5 already? Specifically EXTCODE* tests? based on the status of the hive tests it is kind of expected 😉 Marius, I think the difference between geth<>Nethermind will be in those scenarios: https://hive.pectra-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io/suite.html?suiteid=1737400189-1d288c02b812cef31d12e3420ce36135.json&suitename=eest%2Fconsume-rlp Ugh I expected geth + nethermind/reth to be on one fork and have enough validators to still finalize EEST Devnet-5 1.3.0 release tracker here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/issues/1094 Some EEST PRs still need to be merged but we're working on it 👍 I think a decision needs to be made over https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9248 because if we include that change in the 1.3.0 it would break compatibility with current running devnet client versions. I have no strong preference, I think it depends on if we want to launch devnet-6 with this change ASAP or that we want to keep running devnet-5 for some time (seems there are bugs and forks, so these should be debugged and fixed anyways). EthJS has a branch ready for devnet-6 with the 7702 code change (fun fact: I only had to delete logic): https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/3839 likely we have some time for bugfixes + passing hive tests i need to try to write some spec tests 😄 for those voluntary exits... for now writing local tests in teku at least any idea on a fixed branch? did you guys figure out which client is right? also cc <@543900561460822016> or <@259648573401071617> Pushed the 7623 changes (after-refund floor) to the prague branch. It's probably that?
